scope: All 57 tracked paths at baseline; independent baseline, focused native boundary review and parent validation.
changes: Bounded dynamic-programming action matching preserves provider case, literal punctuation and UTF-16 semantics. A separate 2,000,000-cell matching budget covers grants and exclusions; exhaustion explicitly returns incomplete.
Request-target parsing remains inside the HTTP error boundary.
IAM projection treats brackets literally at resource, action and role-resource gates.
Offline fixture CLI evidence names its actual private native snapshot.

verification.wildcard_before: Actual analysis exceeded a 1500 ms external deadline; killed child process.
verification.wildcard_after: Both toxic grant and exclusion patterns complete under a 4000 ms child deadline. No performance score is claimed.

limitations: Observed graph paths never prove effective cloud permissions.
No cloud API calls or IAM mutation were required for this audit.
Historical AWS acceptance was partial; Azure/GCP account acceptance remains unverified.
hosted_ci_dependency_hardening: Browser setup uses the official HTTPS Ubuntu archive mirror, bounded APT network timeouts and a five-minute step limit. This addresses a runner mirror timeout observed during this five-project audit; package signature verification remains enabled.
